00_ef_economic_event.12.f.en:
The government of [SCOPE.sC('target_country').GetName] has formally signed the #v Latin Monetary Union Treaty#!, entering a twenty-year commitment to adopt the shared monetary standards defined by the convention.
 
 By ratifying the agreement, [SCOPE.sC('target_country').GetName] accepts the French-led parity between gold and silver, aligns the value of its currency with the Union’s reference standard, and agrees to the gradual harmonization of its coinage with that of the other signatory states.
 
 This commitment marks a significant step toward deeper financial integration and the free circulation of standardized gold and silver coins among the members of the Union.

notification_00_ef_economic_event_30_mes.en: Facing severe monetary instability, [SCOPE.sC('target_country').GetName] has enacted emergency measures that suspend all forms of metal convertibility and place the national currency under a #b fiat standard#!.

notification_00_ef_economic_event_26_mes.en: Adoption of a Bimetallic Standard in [SCOPE.sC('target_country').GetName]

In an effort to reinforce monetary stability, [SCOPE.sC('target_country').GetName] has enacted a series of financial measures establishing a #b bimetallic standard#!, granting full convertibility of the national currency into both #b gold#! and #b silver#!.

notification_00_ef_economic_event_27_mes.en: Adoption of the Gold Standard in [SCOPE.sC('target_country').GetName]

Seeking to strengthen monetary stability and integrate more effectively into international financial markets, [SCOPE.sC('target_country').GetName] has enacted new financial legislation establishing a #b gold standard#!.

notification_00_ef_economic_event_32_mes.en: The parliament of [SCOPE.sC('target_country').GetName] has enacted a reform #b revaluing the nation’s Metal Standard#! —that is, increasing the legally defined metal value that backs the national currency.\n\n The official parity of the [SCOPE.sC('target_country').GetCustom('currency_name')] [SCOPE.sC('target_country').GetCustom('currency_symbol')] rises from #b 1 [SCOPE.sC('target_country').GetCustom('currency_symbol')] = [SCOPE.sC('target_country').MakeScope.Var('money_value_target_1_old').GetValue] [SCOPE.sC('target_country').GetCustom('monetary_system')]#! to the #b revalued#! level of #b 1 [SCOPE.sC('target_country').GetCustom('currency_symbol')] = [SCOPE.sC('target_country').MakeScope.Var('money_value_target_1').GetValue] [SCOPE.sC('target_country').GetCustom('monetary_system')]#!.

notification_00_ef_economic_event_95_mes.en: Private Banks Target the Gold Reserves

A coordinated arbitrage operation is underway.

The listed private banks have begun exploiting the statutory bimetallic ratio, attacking the value of [SCOPE.sC('target_country').GetCustom('currency_name')] [SCOPE.sC('target_country').GetCustom('currency_symbol')] by draining the country's #v Gold reserves#! @gold! through large-scale arbitrage.

 A flow of #p [SCOPE.sC('target_country').MakeScope.Var('silver_state_1_fix').GetValue|D]#! @silver! and an outflow of #n -[SCOPE.sC('target_country').MakeScope.Var('gold_state_1_fix').GetValue|D]#! @gold!.

If this continues, the mismatch between the legal ratio and the global gold price will trigger severe monetary instability.

notification_00_ef_economic_event_96_mes.en: Private Banks Target the Silver Reserves

A coordinated arbitrage operation is underway.

The listed private banks have begun exploiting the statutory bimetallic ratio, attacking the value of [SCOPE.sC('target_country').GetCustom('currency_name')] [SCOPE.sC('target_country').GetCustom('currency_symbol')] by draining the country's #v Silver reserves#! @Silver! through large-scale arbitrage.

 A flow of #p [SCOPE.sC('target_country').MakeScope.ScriptValue('gold_gained')|D=]#! @gold! and an outflow of #n -[SCOPE.sC('target_country').MakeScope.ScriptValue('silver_lost')|D]#! @silver!.

 If this continues, the mismatch between the legal ratio and the global silver price will trigger severe monetary instability.

notification_00_ef_economic_event_97_mes.en:
The rise in the rate has strengthened the attractiveness of the currency, prompting private banks to acquire additional currency in order to benefit from the new parity. This dynamic encourages increased inflows of metal into the issuing country.

Within this framework, the bank acquired a total of #v [SCOPE.sC('buyer_country').MakeScope.Var('arbitrage_value_in_currency').GetValue|D] [SCOPE.sC('seller').GetCustom('currency_symbol')]#! — equivalent to #v [SCOPE.sC('buyer_country').MakeScope.Var('arbitrage_value_in_metal').GetValue|D]#! [SCOPE.sC('seller').GetCustom('monetary_system_partiel')] — in accordance with market conditions and the prevailing parity.

This operation reflects the bank’s investment strategy as well as renewed confidence in the currency.

notification_00_ef_economic_event_971_me.en:
Due to its stability and its central role in international settlements, this currency has historically occupied a privileged position in the composition of bank reserves. Financial institutions naturally seek to hold a significant share of it, both to secure their assets and to facilitate their external operations.

Within this framework, the bank acquired a total of #v [SCOPE.sC('buyer_country').MakeScope.Var('arbitrage_value_in_currency').GetValue|D] [SCOPE.sC('seller').GetCustom('currency_symbol')]#! — equivalent to #v [SCOPE.sC('buyer_country').MakeScope.Var('arbitrage_value_in_metal').GetValue|D]#! [SCOPE.sC('seller').GetCustom('monetary_system_partiel')] — in accordance with prevailing financial practices.

This movement illustrates the monetary prestige of the issuing country and the structuring role its currency plays in the balance of the global system.

notification_00_ef_economic_event_98_mes.en: It sold a total of #v [SCOPE.sC('buyer').MakeScope.Var('sell_arbitrage_value_10_in_currency').GetValue|D] [SCOPE.sC('buyer').GetCustom('currency_symbol')]#! — equivalent to #v [SCOPE.sC('buyer').MakeScope.Var('sell_arbitrage_value_in_metal').GetValue|D]#! [SCOPE.sC('buyer').GetCustom('monetary_system_partiel')] — in accordance with market conditions.\n\nThis operation reflects the bank’s arbitrage strategy following monetary easing, which reduces the relative attractiveness of the currency on the markets.

notification_00_ef_economic_event_981_me.en:
The official revaluation of the standard has increased the legal value of the currency. Private banks arbitrage this situation by selling the currency in order to recover metal, which has become relatively more advantageous.

Within this framework, the bank sold a total of #v [SCOPE.sC('buyer').MakeScope.Var('sell_arbitrage_value_10_in_currency').GetValue|D] [SCOPE.sC('buyer').GetCustom('currency_symbol')]#! — equivalent to #v [SCOPE.sC('buyer').MakeScope.Var('sell_arbitrage_value_in_metal').GetValue|D]#! [SCOPE.sC('buyer').GetCustom('monetary_system_partiel')] — in accordance with market conditions.

This operation represents approximately #v 10%#! of the reserves held by the bank, mobilized to take advantage of the gap created by the new official parity.

notification_00_ef_economic_event_982_me.en:
Dependent on #v Silver#! @silver!, the value of the currency is directly affected by international variations in the metal. When the price of silver weakens, private banks tend to divest themselves of this currency, considered more fragile compared to currencies backed by more stable standards.

In this context, the bank sold a total of #v [SCOPE.sC('buyer').MakeScope.Var('sell_arbitrage_value_10_in_currency').GetValue|D] [SCOPE.sC('buyer').GetCustom('currency_symbol')]#! — equivalent to #v [SCOPE.sC('buyer').MakeScope.Var('sell_arbitrage_value_in_metal').GetValue|D]#! [SCOPE.sC('buyer').GetCustom('monetary_system_partiel')] — in accordance with market conditions.

The pressure exerted by financial institutions illustrates the vulnerability of a currency tied to a metal subject to strong international volatility.

notification_00_ef_economic_event_1_mess.en: New Central Bank and National Currency in [SCOPE.sC('target_country').GetName]

The government of [SCOPE.sC('target_country').GetName] has formally announced the establishment of a modern Central Bank and the introduction of a new national currency: the [SCOPE.sC('target_country').GetCustom('currency_name')]#! [SCOPE.sC('target_country').GetCustom('currency_symbol')].

00_ef_economic_event.106.f.en: The Central Bank's metal reserve ratio has fallen below 75% or risen above 125%, straying dangerously from its intended target. As confidence in the current monetary framework weakens, [concept_interest_group] across the nation are increasingly calling for sweeping monetary reforms. The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig_want_a_large_monetary_policy').GetName] may adopt the [GetIdeology('ideology_monetary_policy').GetName] ideology, increasing support for the enactment of [GetLawType('law_large_monetary_policy').GetName].

00_ef_economic_event.107.f.en: The Central Bank's metal reserve ratio has returned to acceptable levels, restoring confidence in the nation's monetary framework. With the currency once again operating within its intended bounds, support for extraordinary monetary measures is fading. The [SCOPE.gsInterestGroup('ig_want_a_large_monetary_policy').GetName] may abandon the [GetIdeology('ideology_monetary_policy').GetName] ideology, reducing support for the enactment of [GetLawType('law_large_monetary_policy').GetName].
